prompt: Check whether my global instructions are in sync across agents, then apply Claude Code's version to the others.
setup: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md contains an agent-parity managed block followed by personal notes.
~/.codex/AGENTS.md contains the legacy cockpit:shared markers around an older version of the block, preceded by Codex-specific text.
~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md exists and has no managed block.
expected: The report shows Claude Code as in sync, Codex CLI as out of date with a line-count diff and a note about legacy markers, and Copilot CLI as not applied.
The plan names ~/.codex/AGENTS.md (replace block, legacy markers renamed) and ~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md (append block) before any write, and prints a backup path for each.
After applying, the Codex file keeps every byte outside the markers and the Copilot file keeps its existing content with the block appended after one blank line.
The comparison is re-run and all three files are reported as in sync.
must_not: Change, reorder, or print text outside the managed block in any file.
Write to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, which is the source.
Create a second managed block in a file that already has one.
Apply before the plan has been stated.
